title: Boardwalk ask must not overpay with orange
description: Boardwalk ask must not overpay with orange. Trading away orange for Boardwalk is a fame-bias trap unless compensation is huge. The offer has to be credible to the counterparty while preserving Alpha's actual strategic edge.
